attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_name = 'RequestError' UNION SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN descendants d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id) SELECT DISTINCT d.symbol_id FROM descendants d JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = d.symbol_id WHERE s.name <> 'RequestError' ORDER BY d.symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from httpx's `RequestError` exception (httpx/_exceptions.py), either directly or through any number of intermediate classes? Exclude RequestError itself. Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Recursively walks class_bases starting from any class whose base is named RequestError, then follows base_symbol_id links to find all transitive subclasses. Joins to symbols to exclude RequestError itself and returns the distinct symbol IDs.
sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_name = 'RequestError' UNION SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN descendants d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id) SELECT DISTINCT d.symbol_id FROM descendants d JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = d.symbol_id WHERE s.name <> 'RequestError' ORDER BY d.symbol_id
